title: Solvable Descent and the Grunwald Problem for Solvable Groups
summary: We prove a suitable fibration theorem over quasi-trivial tori that, through an approach developed by Harpaz and Wittenberg, implies so-called solvable descent. In particular, this gives a positive answer to the Grunwald problem for solvable groups up to the necessary Brauer--Manin obstruction, providing a generalizion of Shafarevich's positive answer to the Inverse Galois Problem for solvable groups.
